title: Burn chart: the 'Financing' label is cut in half at the top of the plot (Month, Year, phone)
found_by: J1, J3, R1, R2, V2 (five walkers)
root_cause: In charts.tsx the label rows are tracked in 'rowEnd', declared in the component body (line 416) but mutated inside the Chart render callback (line 739). If the callback runs more than once for one component render (dev double render, or Chart calling children again after measuring width), the second pass sees the first pass's end position and puts the one label on row 1 (y = top - 12 - 14 = 2 with top 28), above the SVG edge. J1 measured the label at y=2 with only one label.
verification: OBSERVED by five walkers on desktop and phone. CONFIRMED in code: rowEnd is outside the callback (charts.tsx:416) and written at :739; label y at :746. That the callback runs twice is SUSPECTED (it fits J1's y=2 exactly); the fix does not depend on it.
files: apps/web/src/components/finance/charts.tsx:416 (create rowEnd inside the (width) => callback, or compute label rows in a pure pass before rendering)
apps/web/src/components/finance/charts.tsx:417 (top: reserve room for a second row only when two labels collide)
test: render the chart twice with one off-scale financing point and assert the label y >= 8
reach: Anyone with a financing event in the Burn chart (every funded founder); visible on the first Finance screen.
acceptance: With one off-scale Financing point the label's text top is at least 2 px inside the SVG in Month, Quarter and Year views, desktop and 375 px.
Two colliding labels still stack on two rows, both fully visible.
The label position is the same after a hover re-render.
